title: Too Many Ads! Official Modpack
description: The official modpack for Too Many Ads!
body:
This is the official modpack for Too Many Ads! This modpack has a few common vanilla plus-ish mods. This modpack also uses explorers compass to make it easier to find the structures in the mod this modpack is based around, Too Many Ads! It ads mods that make this just a little bit nicer to play Too Many Ads!, such as JEI, Jade, and AppleSkin.

Too Many Ads: https://modrinth.com/mod/too-many-ads



I made this to make it easier to play my mod Too Many Ads!
